description: Template. Copy to eval/corpus.local.json (gitignored) or point --corpus / VC_EVAL_CORPUS at your own file. Each entry: a Claude Code session transcript by ABSOLUTE path (never copy transcripts into this public repo), the segment index after splitting it at compact_boundary rows (eval/parse.ts), and a label. Mark at most one segment live: true (its next segment is a real verbatim compaction). A missing file or segment is skipped with a warning.
